# Entry points .github/check_unwired.py cannot see a caller for, because nothing calls them by a name in the code:
# a command looked up by a computed name, a hook the host calls by convention.
# One per line: `src/path/to/module.py::name  # why nothing calls it by name`. The reason is required, and an entry
# whose path no longer exists fails the check. A helper that is simply not wired yet does not belong here.

# Graphs: harness/registry.py walks the graphs package with pkgutil and imports every module that has a SPEC.
src/graphs/graphs/ops/epic_reconcile.py::epic_reconcile  # graph module, discovered by harness/registry.py's package walk
src/graphs/graphs/ops/retro_propose.py::retro_propose  # graph module, discovered by harness/registry.py's package walk

# Migrations: harness/store_migrate.default_modules walks the harness package for store_ddl_NNNN and calls each one's
# `statements(dialect)` through the module object.
src/graphs/harness/store_ddl_0019.py::statements  # migration module, discovered by store_migrate.default_modules' package walk
src/graphs/harness/store_ddl_0020.py::statements  # migration module, discovered by store_migrate.default_modules' package walk
src/graphs/harness/store_ddl_0021.py::statements  # migration module, discovered by store_migrate.default_modules' package walk

# Commands a person runs as `python -m <module>`, documented where they are used.
src/graphs/harness/graphdoc.py::graphdoc  # `python -m harness.graphdoc`, docs/customize/write-a-graph.md
src/graphs/harness/store_backfill.py::store_backfill  # `python -m harness.store_backfill`, src/graphs/docs/STORAGE.md
src/graphs/harness/store_card_keys.py::store_card_keys  # `python -m harness.store_card_keys URL`, run by a person (its docstring)
src/graphs/harness/store_classify.py::store_classify  # `python -m harness.store_classify`, docs/releases/0.18.0.md
src/graphs/harness/store_notify.py::store_notify  # `python -m harness.store_notify --store-url URL`, its docstring: watching the triggers during the soak
src/tools/agent_tools/store_restore_drill.py::store_restore_drill  # `-m agent_tools.store_restore_drill` in ops/store-backup/coxswain-store-drill.service

# pytest calls its hooks by name; the suites' conftest.py files import them.
src/graphs/harness/serial_tests.py::pytest_collection_modifyitems  # pytest hook
src/graphs/harness/serial_tests.py::pytest_sessionfinish  # pytest hook
src/graphs/harness/extras_tests.py::register  # called from each suite's conftest.py pytest_configure

# sources.adapter_for imports `agent_tools.source_<name>` by a computed name.
src/tools/agent_tools/source_folder.py::source_folder  # source adapter, imported by name in sources.adapter_for
src/tools/agent_tools/source_github.py::source_github  # source adapter, imported by name in sources.adapter_for
src/tools/agent_tools/sources.py::SourceAdapter  # the Protocol every adapter module, built-in or a coxswain.sources plugin, implements
